answer: A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, locking 69 POA that is slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. The wander of the register names the voucher for every alias, so a farm's whole sponsor ladder is visible at once; the grove of a conviction climbs the chain, and the prism of slashed bonds pays the auditors who caught it. No honest sponsor risks real money on a stranger, so 435 fakes need 435 bought sponsors.
